retrieval: Build-time HTTPS FetchContent only; every archive is SHA256-verified. No runtime network access.
resolution: Release tags were resolved through the GitHub git refs/tag APIs to the commits below. Archive bytes were downloaded from immutable commit URLs and hashed before pinning.

dependencies.name: FreeType
dependencies.license: FTL, including bundled BDF/PCF/hash MIT and internal zlib notices
dependencies.linkage: static; external zlib, bzip2, PNG, Brotli and HarfBuzz integration disabled

dependencies.name: HarfBuzz
dependencies.license: Old MIT, with Microsoft MIT notice for ms-use
dependencies.linkage: static; OpenType shaping and built-in Unicode functions; all optional external integrations disabled

runtime.macos: OS-provided libc++ and libSystem only; no third-party dynamic libraries
runtime.windows_msvc: CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY=MultiThreaded (MultiThreadedDebug in Debug); build using a properly licensed Microsoft toolchain and its applicable static CRT redistribution terms
runtime.windows_mingw: static libgcc and libstdc++ requested; not locally validated
